title: The pullback of an injective module along a continuous and cocontinuous morphism whose lower shriek commutes with fibre products is totally acyclic
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a continuous and cocontinuous functor of sites whose lower shriek on sheaves of sets commutes with fibre products, the pullback of an injective module along the associated morphism of topoi is totally acyclic (statement lines 9470-9482). The proof (proof lines 9484-9508) checks condition (1) of the total acyclicity criterion, computes the sections over fibre products through the commutativity hypothesis, and concludes with the total acyclicity of injective modules and the converse of the criterion. H2: two independent inputs and one computation, written out in full.
